data.name: email.invite.subject
data.value: You've been invited to {0} on Dependably
data.comment: Invite email subject line. {0} = the organization (tenant) name.

data.name: email.invite.body
data.value:
You have been invited to join {0} on Dependably.
Accept your invitation using the link below. The link expires at {1} UTC.
{2}
If you were not expecting this invitation, you can ignore this email.
data.comment: Plain-text invite email body. {0} = organization name, {1} = expiry timestamp, {2} = invite link. Keep the blank lines and the trailing newline.

data.name: email.reset.subject
data.value: Reset your Dependably password
data.comment: Subject line of the self-serve "forgot password" reset email.

data.name: email.reset.body
data.value:
A password reset was requested for your Dependably account.
Reset your password using the link below. The link expires at {0} UTC and can only be used once.
{1}
If you did not request this, you can ignore this email — your password will not be changed.
data.comment: Plain-text password-reset email body. {0} = expiry timestamp, {1} = reset link. Keep the blank lines and the trailing newline.

data.name: email.security.mfaEnabled.subject
data.value: Two-factor authentication was enabled on your Dependably account
data.comment: Subject line of the account-security notification sent when MFA is enabled.

data.name: email.security.mfaEnabled.body
data.value:
Two-factor authentication was enabled on your Dependably account on {0} UTC.
If this was you, no action is needed.
If you did not make this change, sign in and disable two-factor authentication immediately, then change your password.
data.comment: Plain-text MFA-enabled security notification body. {0} = event timestamp. Keep the blank lines and the trailing newline.

data.name: email.security.mfaDisabled.subject
data.value: Two-factor authentication was disabled on your Dependably account
data.comment: Subject line of the account-security notification sent when MFA is disabled.

data.name: email.security.mfaDisabled.body
data.value:
Two-factor authentication was disabled on your Dependably account on {0} UTC.
If this was you, no action is needed.
If you did not make this change, sign in and re-enable two-factor authentication immediately, then change your password.
data.comment: Plain-text MFA-disabled security notification body. {0} = event timestamp. Keep the blank lines and the trailing newline.

data.name: email.security.passwordChanged.subject
data.value: Your Dependably password was changed
data.comment: Subject line of the account-security notification sent when the account password changes.

data.name: email.security.passwordChanged.body
data.value:
Your Dependably account password was changed on {0} UTC.
If this was you, no action is needed.
If you did not make this change, contact your administrator immediately — your account may be compromised.
data.comment: Plain-text password-changed security notification body. {0} = event timestamp. Keep the blank lines and the trailing newline.
